notes: Posted 26 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (9)': You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed (posted 'Profit'), Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol ('Han w/Heavy'), Tatooine: Jabba's Palace ('JP'), Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber ('AC'), Podrace Prep, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer and K'lor'slug; these count toward the total. K'lor'slug is posted as 'K'lor Slug (The Camp vs. MKOS/Court)' - the poster starts The Camp instead against My Kind Of Scum or Court decks (The Camp is also in the Effects list); K'lor'slug is shown as the starting effect.
Total as published is 56, not 60: the Characters heading says 18 but 14 characters are listed; the other sections match their headings.

Posted 'Junland Wastes (or whatever the drain 2 one is)' dested Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut: Jundland Wastes is a Dark-side site only, and the strategy's location notes name the three sites as 'outskirts', 'Obi's hut revoed is a drain 3' and 'tosche'; Obi-Wan's Hut is the Light site with two Light Force icons.

Posted 'Courage' dested Courage Of A Skywalker (the only Light Interrupt of that name in the era; duel destiny for a lightsaber deck). 'Learner Obi' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; 'Profissancy' dested Lightsaber Proficiency (four lightsabers in the list).

Posted 'Ani's/Lukes/Quis/Obis Stick' dested Anakin's Lightsaber, Luke's Lightsaber, Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber and Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (the section is headed 'Green'); 'Clash of Sticks' dested Clash Of Sabers; 'Naburn' dested Nabrun Leids; 'Sence' dested plain Sense; 'Revo' Revolution; 'Honor' Honor Of The Jedi; 'Camp' The Camp; 'Leia with Gun' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Lando with Axe' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Chewie Protector' Chewbacca, Protector; 'Bouush' Boushh.
'JP' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'AC' the Light Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber.
The strategy says to swap out 'the SA' for Control & Tunnel Vision and The Signal; no such card is in the list, and the list is kept as published.
